doc_friction.issue: `targets --probe 20` with no --under scans every target and outlasts a 115 s timeout without output; narrowing with --under ventures/<v> worked instantly. Worth saying to always pass --under when probing.
unwired check_csv_formula_guard.py globs ventures/ while another parallel suite creates and removes ventures/.share-location-fixture, so it can fail with FileNotFoundError (flake; passes alone).

notes: Step 0: 12 open entries. All are control-plane or need a new eval set, so none could be fixed here. Campaigns: mrr-pulse/metrics.mjs caught 8/10, rev-rec/revrec.mjs caught 8/10 (2 equivalent). The hunt found that rev-rec reads $(100.00) and (100.00) USD as +100. A probe over every exported amount parser found the same anchored /^\(.*\)$/ test in 48 ventures. The first CI run went red: reseller-books keeps byte-identical copies of five fixed calc.mjs files in engines/, so its drift test failed. Re-copied them, plus 2 more in sales-export-to-journal. The guard first looked only at calc/csv/ro-import.mjs. It now walks every non-test .mjs and found one more (economic-nexus orders.mjs). Guard added: platform/ci/test_accounting_negatives.mjs. On its first run it failed on 47 files, then on 1 more after widening; it is green after the fix. run_venture_tests.py --since origin/main: 55 suites run, 0 failed. Unwired checks: 237/238 passed. The one failure, check_csv_formula_guard.py, hit FileNotFoundError on ventures/.share-location-fixture, a temp dir another parallel test makes and deletes. Run alone, it passes.

real_defects.file: ventures/rev-rec/csv.mjs (and 47 sibling amount parsers, plus 7 vendored engine copies)
real_defects.issue: Negative detection /^\(.*\)$/ missed '$(100.00)' (Excel Accounting format), '$ (100.00)', '(100.00) USD' and 'USD (100.00)'; the parser then stripped non-digits and returned +100, so refunds and fees read as income in 48 ventures (plus vendored copies in reseller-books and sales-export-to-journal). Fixed with /\([^()]*\d[^()]*\)/; guard platform/ci/test_accounting_negatives.mjs checks every exported parseNumber/parseMoney/parseAmount/parseCents.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: find, fix and test one parser bug across 47 tools, plus a CI guard and 20-mutant triage

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
